subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack retain Matrix-specific calls in the generic QA SDK and change global channel-restart admission in the same PR, or must those concerns be moved or split before merge?
rationale: Repository architecture keeps generic SDK surfaces plugin-agnostic, while the production reload change affects a substantially broader lifecycle than the Matrix proof exercises.

options.title: Refactor boundaries before merge
options.body: Keep Matrix delegation behind a generic or bundled-internal seam and split or directly prove the global restart-admission change before landing the scenario migration.

options.title: Approve the coupled design
options.body: Explicitly accept the Matrix-specific SDK contract and global lifecycle change, authorize the dependency graph, and require direct handler-level and representative non-Matrix reload proof.

recommendation.title: Refactor boundaries before merge
recommendation.body: Keep Matrix delegation behind a generic or bundled-internal seam and split or directly prove the global restart-admission change before landing the scenario migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged prerequisite and current stacked migration and are best positioned to propose the boundary-preserving revision for owner approval.
